title: N-Queens First Solution
statement:
Given N, find and print one valid solution to the N-Queens problem.

Represent the board as N rows, each row containing the column index (0-based) of the queen placed in that row.

Print the solution as N space-separated column indices on a single line.

If no solution exists, print "NONE".
outputFormat: N space-separated integers (0-indexed column of queen in each row), or "NONE" if impossible.

examples.explanation: Queens at columns [1,3,0,2]: no two share a row, column, or diagonal.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
# Write your solution here
# Hint: place one queen per row; use sets for cols, diag1, diag2
# Return the first valid placement found
